limitations: Removing public const-callability can break downstream const contexts; public use requires compatibility review
rules.title: const-fn

limitations: Integer width, float precision, units, serialization, alignment, and conversion cost are domain contracts
Do not downgrade geospatial or scientific precision without an explicit error budget
rules.title: mem-smaller-integers

limitations: Fewer codegen units can improve optimization while increasing compile time and reducing build parallelism
rules.title: opt-codegen-units

limitations: Do not infer branch probability from source order alone
Channel support must be detected rather than stated from a static Rust version
rules.title: opt-likely-hint

limitations: LTO can materially increase link time and does not guarantee a runtime improvement
rules.title: opt-lto-release

limitations: PGO is only as representative as the collected workload and must be repeated after material changes
rules.title: opt-pgo-profile

limitations: Portable SIMD may require nightly
Platform intrinsics require target and safety qualification
rules.title: opt-simd-portable

limitations: target-cpu=native can make artifacts non-portable and is inappropriate for generic distribution
rules.title: opt-target-cpu

limitations: Do not use universal byte thresholds
Boxing adds allocation, indirection, and cache effects
Compiler optimizations may elide moves
rules.title: own-move-large

limitations: Hashers are security and compatibility choices; untrusted-input DoS risk and deterministic-output requirements must be assessed
rules.title: perf-ahash

limitations: Use stable extend when collect_into is unavailable
Channel support must be detected
rules.title: perf-collect-into

limitations: opt-level, LTO, codegen units, panic strategy, and stripping are independent trade-offs
Diagnostic, size, throughput, startup, compile-time, and crash-policy goals may require different profiles
rules.title: perf-release-profile

limitations: Passing Miri is evidence rather than proof of soundness
Safe local code may still exercise unsafe dependencies
Unsupported system interactions may require a targeted subset
rules.title: unsafe-miri-ci
